blocks.title: Atomic orbital
blocks.text: An atomic orbital is the three-dimensional region in space around the nucleus in which the probability of finding the electron is maximum.

The orbitals of each subshell have their own shapes, set by the azimuthal quantum number, and their own orientations, set by the magnetic quantum number. The next three topics describe the s, p, d and f orbitals in turn.
